concerns.text: FR-001(c) (correlation filtering) is present in spec.md but explicitly overridden by plan.md. Tasks T014c (Spec-default) and T014d (Plan-override) both exist. T014c implements logic forbidden by the ratified plan. This creates a coverage conflict where the task list instructs implementation of a requirement that the plan explicitly voids, risking code that violates the project's single source of truth.

FR-007 (VIF removal) is present in spec.md but overridden by plan.md (diagnostic only). Tasks T031a (Spec-default removal) and T031b (Plan-override diagnostic) both exist. T031a instructs implementation of feature removal logic that the plan explicitly forbids. This is a coverage conflict similar to T014c/T014d.

SC-003 (dataset bootstrapping) is present in spec.md but overridden by plan.md (SHAP-only resampling). Tasks T033a (Spec-default bootstrapping) and T033b (Plan-override SHAP-only) both exist. T033a instructs implementation of dataset resampling logic that the plan explicitly forbids. This creates a coverage conflict.

T018 (Save descriptors.parquet) is marked incomplete but depends on T014 (preprocess_2d.py implementation) which is also marked incomplete. The task list does not provide a clear path to generate the required artifact for downstream tasks (T019, T031, T032) without resolving the T014c/T014d conflict first. The implementer cannot satisfy the data flow requirement.

T006 (Setup tests/contract/ schema validators) is marked incomplete. It is a prerequisite for T019 (runtime assertion using validators). Without a defined schema (JSON Schema/Pydantic) in the task description or a linked artifact, the implementer cannot satisfy the requirement to 'use the schema validators from T006' for T019.

T014c, T014d, T031a, T031b, T033a, T033b are tagged with '[Spec-Default]' and '[Plan-Override]'. While the intent is to show the conflict, the task list should not include the 'Spec-Default' tasks as executable items if the Plan explicitly voids them. These tasks should be marked 'DEPRECATED' or removed to prevent the implementer from writing code that violates the ratified plan.
